name: Switch Order
definition: Transfer from one investment fund/fund class to another investment fund or investment fund class by the investor. A switch is composed of one or several subscription legs, and one or several redemption legs.

AdditionalCashIn.name: Additional Cash In
AdditionalCashIn.definition: Additional amount of money paid by the investor in addition to the switch redemption amount.

ResultingCashOut.name: Resulting Cash Out
ResultingCashOut.definition: Amount of money that results from a switch-out, that is not reinvested in another investment fund, and is repaid to the investor.

TotalRedemptionAmount.name: Total Redemption Amount
TotalRedemptionAmount.definition: Amount of money used to derive the quantity of investment fund units to be redeemed.

TotalSubscriptionAmount.name: Total Subscription Amount
TotalSubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount of money used to derive the quantity of investment fund units to be subscribed.

RedemptionLeg.name: Redemption Leg
RedemptionLeg.definition: Part of an investment fund switch order that is a redemption.

SubscriptionLeg.name: Subscription Leg
SubscriptionLeg.definition: Part of an investment fund switch order that is a subscription.
